book: Rodolphus Goclenius, Ratio solvendi vitiosas argumentationes, Pars Critices (Marburg, 1597): a Latin logic treatise on refuting fallacious arguments, built as front matter (dedication, preface, a prolegomenal question), the Pars Critices in six numbered chapters plus a closing chapter, twelve Quæstiones, and back matter (an invitation to students, an address to the reader, a poem).
